newsitem.title: USA: Calif. lawmakers considers L.A. transit takeover.
newsitem.headline: Calif. lawmakers considers L.A. transit takeover.

text.p: A California lawmaker may introduce a bill calling for the state take over the financially-troubled Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority, a spokesman said on Thursday.

Senator Tom Hayden, a Los Angeles Democrat, is "seriously considering" amending a bill already in the state legislature to place the authority under a state receiver, Rocky Rushing, Hayden's chief of staff, said.
"It would be a state takeover to protect state interests in the agency," Rushing said. "From Sacramento looking south, it would appear this agency is suffering from a meltdown."
